## Natural history notes

A large orb-weaving spider characterized by its oval abdomen with pale yellow, white, and dark bands, along with long banded legs. In Florida, it is found in fields, gardens, grasslands, roadsides, marsh edges, yards, and other sunny areas with grasses or low vegetation for web attachment. It builds large circular webs to capture flying insects and often rests near the center of the web during the day.
